name: adaptive-task-router
description: Automatically recommend the minimum sufficient ChatGPT surface, available model, and reasoning effort for each substantive task.

interface.shortDescription: Choose the right surface, model, and reasoning effort.
interface.longDescription: ATR recommends a minimum sufficient configuration, including upgrades and downgrades, and waits for your decision before execution. It compares settings only when observable and never changes them itself.
defaultPrompt: Recommend the minimum sufficient configuration for my task.
